body: STORY-1171 #1873: RequestChanges (revision 2) — real deterministic bug, NOT the merge-lock logic. Root cause: in cli.rs you inserted the MergeLock doc+variant BETWEEN Ps's doc-comment block and Ps {, so Rust attaches Ps's doc to MergeLock and Ps { is left with an empty about. The hard catalog test then fails: missing one-line about for aida ps (help_catalog_tests.rs:114). Failed twice on the same SHA (not a flake); the temp-dir conflict.txt merge lines are an unrelated conflict-test's expected output. Fix: relocate the MergeLock doc+variant so it doesn't split Ps from its doc (put it just before Ps's doc block, or after Ps's closing brace), then confirm visible_catalog_requires_about_for_every_command passes. Also a few non-fatal unused-import/var warnings in merge_lock.rs worth a cargo fix. The primitive itself is approved on the merits — this is purely CLI-doc placement. Rebase onto current main while you are at it (it is a few commits behind), then ping me and I will merge on green.
